baseline_models.mechanism: The heart becomes pressure-bearing content at the throat, while k-z-m supplies held breath or silence and the sealing of a filled outlet; the body is a closed conduit with no release.

activation_trace.role: The heart or inner faculty supplies the content forced out of its ordinary interior position.
The throat supplies the narrow bodily outlet where the displaced interior becomes lodged.
Held breath and silence make the lodged heart a respiratory and vocal blockage.
Sealing an outlet after filling turns the body into a pressurized closed vessel.

changed_reading.before: They are terrified, with their hearts in their throats.
changed_reading.after: Terror is rendered as a pressure system: the inner core is driven into a narrow outlet and then prevented from becoming breath or speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ما للظالمين من حميم ولا شفيع يطاع
baseline_models.mechanism: Hamim supplies pre-existing intimate access, shafi supplies a second party who joins another's case, and yuta supplies successful uptake. The double negation removes both relational access and actionable advocacy.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and blocking a right identifies the people whose own support channels are now blocked.
Close kin supplies the pre-existing bond that the first negation removes.
An advocate joining another's need supplies the added support that the second negation removes.
Compliance supplies the missing conversion of an advocate's speech into effective action.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers will have neither a friend nor an accepted intercessor.
changed_reading.after: Their entire support circuit fails: neither inherited closeness nor recruited advocacy can obtain institutional uptake.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يوم الآزفة ... ما للظالمين من حميم
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus juxtaposes two kinds of nearness. The occurrence draws near, while the near person who might meet it with them is absent; proximity migrates from human relation to the threatening event.

activation_trace.role: Approach and narrowing time make the event the positively present near term.
The day as a severe occurrence gives the approaching term event-density rather than mere calendar duration.
The root's image of an affair drawing near echoes azifa even as the surface form is negated.
The close relative supplies the human nearness that has vanished.

changed_reading.before: An imminent day arrives when no close friend is available.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs a proximity transfer: the event becomes inescapably near precisely as protective human nearness disappears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent exposure sequence makes the throat a disclosure threshold. What is hidden in the breast is driven toward the vocal boundary, but k-z-m holds it there, visible in its effects yet unavailable as usable speech.

activation_trace.role: The heart supplies the interior content moving toward exposure.
The throat supplies the boundary between hidden interior and public voice.
Held breath and silence prevent near-disclosure from becoming effective utterance.
Emergence and uncovering establish the scene's movement from concealed to exposed.
Concealment is explicitly denied, making hiddenness unstable before the focus image.
The same concealment image returns immediately after the focus as an action of the breasts.
The breast as the source from which actions issue locates the hidden material below the throat.

structural_cues: 40:16 says the subjects are exposed and that nothing of them is hidden.
40:19 immediately relocates concealment inside the breasts after the focus body's heart-to-throat movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, hidden breasts, heart, throat, and held silence; I infer an inside-to-boundary movement toward forced disclosure. The live alternative is a purely physiological terror image with no disclosure arrow.

changed_reading.before: The heart-at-throat image is a sealed fear response.
changed_reading.after: It is also forced near-disclosure: the concealed interior reaches the threshold of voice but cannot control or release what its body reveals.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of kin and advocate is procedural rather than arbitrary. Those defined by blocked rights enter a judgment with no wrong in it and a ruling fixed to truth, so relationship and patronage cannot relocate what is due.

activation_trace.role: Blocking another's right supplies the offense mirrored by the loss of privileged access.
Close kin supplies the patronage route that cannot alter the outcome.
Joined advocacy supplies the second patronage route that cannot alter the outcome.
Compliance marks the specifically denied ability to turn influence into a ruling.
The explicit absence of blocked rights establishes a non-corrupt adjudicative frame.
Decisive judgment contrasts the one effective ruling with the inability of invoked others to rule anything.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the standard that patronage cannot bend.

structural_cues: 40:17 places individual recompense and no injustice directly before the focus.
40:20 places judgment by truth and the impotence of other invoked powers directly after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recompense, no blocked right, decisive judgment, and ineffective alternatives; I infer that the missing intimate and advocate mark an anti-patronage safeguard. The alternative is simple helplessness without a procedural claim.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers happen to lack helpers at judgment.
changed_reading.after: Their lack of helpers is part of incorruptible procedure: neither kinship nor attached advocacy can displace a right-sized ruling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly tests whether speech produces uptake. Those called toward faith refuse; followers later appeal through leaders and keepers; the resulting calls do not change anything, despite an earlier open direct call-and-answer circuit. Yuta is therefore the endpoint of a reversed responsiveness pattern.

activation_trace.role: The intercessor supplies speech made on behalf of another within a response chain.
Obedient uptake supplies the missing final conversion of speech into action.
A call that bends hearers toward faith establishes the invitation they refused.
Loyal following supplies the failed hierarchy through which dependents seek relief from former leaders.
The prisoners try to move the keepers by speech so that another petition will be made.
The imperative to call and the resulting call preserve utterance while explicitly stripping it of arrival.
Answering speech establishes the available direct response circuit against which the later failed relay is measured.

structural_cues: 40:10 pairs being called toward faith with refusal.
40:47-50 stages a relay from followers to leaders to keepers to a further call, with no relief.
40:60 places a direct call-and-answer offer beside the consequence of arrogance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refused invitation, failed mediated petitions, and an offered direct answer; I infer a reversal in which refusal to respond matures into speech that receives no effective response. The alternative is thematic contrast without a causal reversal.

changed_reading.after: No speech in their support reaches actionable uptake; the passive yuta condenses a surah-wide history of inverted calling and answering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Approach, arrival, sight, and benefit form a temporal threshold. Warning operates while the event is nearing; once force becomes visible, a newly voiced response no longer benefits, so the imperative to warn is an intervention before closure rather than scene-setting.

activation_trace.role: Warning supplies information meant to awaken caution while response remains possible.
Nearness supplies the shrinking interval in which warning can still work.
Coming and arrival confirm that the approaching event is moving toward actual presence.
Direct sight supplies the moment when approach becomes undeniable encounter.
The denial of benefit marks sight as the far side of the actionable threshold.
Repeated direct sight links the loss of benefit specifically to visible arrival.

structural_cues: 40:59 states that the Hour is coming while most do not believe.
40:84-85 sequences seeing force, voicing belief, and that belief no longer benefiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approach, coming, sight, and non-benefit; I infer a closing response window and assign warning to its still-open side. The alternative is that these are separate assurances with no precise threshold mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Warn them by announcing a frightening imminent day.
changed_reading.after: Warn them now because nearness is the last usable interval before visible arrival makes a new response non-beneficial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later collar-neck-chain-drag sequence externalizes the focus body's internal stoppage. A heart lodged at the throat and a sealed outlet become an imposed apparatus around the same bodily corridor, converting felt arrest into material restraint and forced motion.

activation_trace.role: The throat supplies the internal corridor later surrounded at the neck.
A sealed full outlet supplies the initial internal arrest.
A collar that binds a member materializes the stoppage as an imposed restraint.
The neck locates the external apparatus around the focus throat.
Connected links extend a local neck blockage into a larger restraint system.
Dragging converts inability to release oneself into motion controlled from outside.

structural_cues: 40:71 places collar, neck, chains, and dragging in one uninterrupted bodily sequence.
The focus and 40:71 share the same throat-neck corridor but reverse agency: internal pressure first, external traction later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an internal throat seal and a later external neck apparatus; I infer material externalization of the same arrest. The alternative is that the two bodily images are independent depictions of distress.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers feel internally choked by terror.
changed_reading.after: Their internal loss of bodily release anticipates an external regime of collaring and dragging through the same neck-throat corridor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated hamim changes the kind of contact available. At the focus, intimate human warmth is absent; later, the same rooted form names the hot medium into which they are drawn, while kindling intensifies it. Relational warmth is replaced by injurious heat.

activation_trace.role: The close loving relative supplies denied human warmth and proximity.
The same rooted form now supplies scalding water as unavoidable physical contact.
Kindling and intensifying fire convert the lexical temperature shift into a punitive thermal mechanism.

structural_cues: The exact rooted form hamim occurs in the focus denial and again at 40:72 as the surrounding medium.
40:72 moves directly from hamim into fire and kindling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root with intimate and hot-water branches plus exact recurrence; I infer a rhetorical replacement of relational warmth by injurious heat. The alternative is ordinary polysemy without a designed substitution.

changed_reading.before: They have no close friend, and later they encounter hot water.
changed_reading.after: The surah turns hamim against them: the warm proximity of a person is absent, while the burning proximity of a medium becomes inescapable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes containment that can release testimony from containment that ends in blockage. Breath or spirit carries warning; the believing man conceals faith yet emits sustained speech; the focus recipients hold breath and cannot secure an effective speaking proxy.

activation_trace.role: Warning supplies speech whose function is to move danger-awareness into another.
Held breath and silence supply terminal containment at the receiving end.
Air and breath give the cast spirit a material communication resonance before the warning clause.
The contextual warning repeats the focus function as transmission from above through a chosen speaker.
Sound-retention is activated by a concealing believer who immediately converts hidden commitment into public speech.
Voiced utterance shows that concealment can remain permeable and release protective testimony.

structural_cues: 40:15 sequences casting spirit, command, and warning.
40:28 introduces the believer as concealing faith and then gives him an extended public address.
The focus pairs held breath or silence with the absence of an effective advocate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breath-spirit, warning, concealment, voiced speech, and held silence; I infer a contrast between permeable storage and terminal closure. The alternative is that katama denotes only strategic secrecy and has no respiratory relation to kazm.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts a speaking warner with speechless frightened recipients.
changed_reading.after: It closes a communication circuit developed across the surah: warning and faithful concealment can release truth, whereas their containment has become a seal that neither breath nor proxy speech can cross.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the anatomy strongly invites fear, but the focus k-z-m inventory explicitly supplies retained anger and 40:10 supplies severe loathing, including self-directed loathing. It remains anchored in kazimin; downstream prose should carry swallowed hostility only as a coexisting affective pressure, not replace terror with anger.

activation_trace.role: Holding anger inside makes kazimin capable of carrying unexpressed hostility as well as respiratory distress.
Severe loathing, including loathing directed at the self, supplies the affect that may be swallowed at the focus.

changed_reading.before: Kazimin means they choke back breath under fear.
changed_reading.after: Alongside fear, they may be swallowing rage, self-loathing, or protest that cannot become efficacious speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because bilad at 40:4 ordinarily denotes lands, yet its inventory also supplies chest and upper sternum while the same verse supplies bodily turning through q-l-b. The focus anchors the activation with literal hearts and throats. Downstream prose should call it a spatial rhyme: deceptive outward mobility is miniaturized and reversed inside the body, not claim that bilad lexically means the focus torso here.

activation_trace.role: The literal heart supplies the internal traveler in the exploratory spatial mapping.
The throat supplies the body's terminal region to which the inner traveler is displaced.
Turning a thing from face to face supplies the outward roaming that is reversed into involuntary inner displacement.
The chest and upper-sternum branch lets the lands image resonate, exploratorily, as a somatic geography.

changed_reading.before: Their worldly movement through lands ends in a static heart-at-throat panic.
changed_reading.after: Their deceptive freedom of turning through external lands is spatially reversed: the heart itself is turned through the body's geography and trapped at its throat frontier.

strongest_changes: The throat became an exposure threshold: concealed interior rises toward voice yet is sealed there.
The missing intimate and intercessor became an anti-patronage rule inside exact judgment and a failed call-response circuit.
The warning became a time-window intervention before visible arrival makes a new response non-beneficial.
Later neck restraints externalize the internal seal, while hamim flips from absent intimate to scalding medium.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context turned one compressed bodily scene into a junction of exposure, adjudication, communication, and material restraint; the exact recurrence of hamim produced the sharpest lexical reversal.
remaining_uncertainties: The heart-to-throat motion may remain an idiom of terror rather than support the full conduit and disclosure mechanisms.
The hamim recurrence may be ordinary polysemy rather than a deliberate replacement of relational warmth by heat.
The refused-call and unanswered-petition sequence may be contrast rather than a causal reversal.
The body-as-landscape outlier depends on a branch-distant bilad image and should remain explicitly exploratory.
